content.title: Banner Engineering 411-3877 RTD Temperature Sensor, 24 VDC, Max 400°C
content.short_description: Banner Engineering 411-3877 is an RTD-type temperature sensor operating on 24 VDC supply voltage with a maximum operating temperature rating of 400°C.
content.long_description:
The Banner Engineering 411-3877 is an RTD (Resistance Temperature Detector) sensor designed for temperature monitoring in industrial process and equipment applications. The sensor operates on a 24 VDC supply and is rated for a maximum operating temperature of 400°C, suitable for higher-heat monitoring points within its rated range.

As an RTD sensor type, the 411-3877 provides temperature measurement based on resistance change characteristics typical of RTD elements. Confirm mounting style, output signal type, and probe length against your application drawings prior to installation, as these details are not specified here.

Verify supply voltage compatibility (24 VDC) with your control system or PLC input module before wiring. Ensure ambient and process temperatures at the installation point remain at or below the 400°C maximum operating temperature to avoid sensor damage or measurement drift.
bullets: Suitable for industrial temperature monitoring applications requiring RTD-based measurement
